funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage who have a confirmed publisher and a scheduled publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles related to British art, visual culture or architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (up to £8,000) and postdoctoral level or equivalent (up to £20,000); open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to undertake projects in British art, visual culture or architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 total (one year or split over two years part‑time)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) at a UK institution, commencing between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree that will bring new perspectives to the understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a doctorate at a UK university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; includes international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research that expands understanding of British art, covering tuition and living expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral‑level individuals (or equivalent experience) seeking to undertake a major research project in British art.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.
